source.note: 1994 Upper Deck Football. The 330-card base set was distributed in one series. VCS uses one universal standard 12-card pack and includes both Hobby- and Retail-specific Predictor families while excluding mail-in exchange sets, promos, and Pro Bowl Samples.

decisions.canonicalPackFormat: Hobby/Retail standard red-wrapper configuration: 12 cards per pack, 36 packs per box.
decisions.packChannelAbstraction: VCS uses one universal pack. Hobby-only Predictors: Award Winners and Retail-only Predictors: League Leaders both remain available in the universal VCS pack at their published 1:20 channel odds, consistent with the existing Set Factory treatment of channel-exclusive insert families.
decisions.baseStructure: One complete #1-330 Base ProductSet with equal base-card availability.
decisions.parallelStructure: Electric and Electric Gold are full 330-card parallels derived from Base so card numbering, teams, subjects, and collector checklist integrity stay synchronized.
decisions.trueRookieNaming: RC is appended only to Base subjects returned by TCDB's rookie index. Short printed subset abbreviations such as SR, HW, and CL remain display-safe in Player where present.
decisions.variationHandling: TCDB lists Emmitt Smith #157 as 157a ERR and 157b COR. VCS intentionally keeps one logical #157 card only, sourced from the corrected 157b entry. ERR/COR detail is omitted from Player and Variant.
decisions.teamlessInsertHandling: Generic Predictor Long Shot cards are legitimate league-wide subjects with no team assignment. They remain teamless rather than inventing NFL, League, Multiple, or another artificial team value.
decisions.excludedRelatedSets: Predictors Exchange: Award Winners and Predictors Exchange: League Leaders are mail-in redemption-result sets and are excluded from ordinary pack outcomes. The Joe Montana promo and Pro Bowl Samples are also excluded.
decisions.releaseSafety: Product remains unreleased until pricing and images are reviewed.

productSets.name: Electric
productSets.notes: Full 330-card silver-foil parallel. Inserted one per standard Hobby/Retail pack; specially marked Retail packs contained two. VCS uses the standard 1:1 rate.

productSets.name: Electric Gold
productSets.notes: Full 330-card gold-foil parallel. Inserted 1:35 Hobby packs; special Retail distribution existed separately. VCS uses the documented Hobby rate.

productSets.name: Predictors: Award Winners
productSets.notes: HP1-HP20. Hobby-only predictor cards inserted 1:20 Hobby packs. Exchange-result mail-in set is excluded.

productSets.name: Predictors: League Leaders
productSets.notes: RP1-RP30. Retail-only predictor cards inserted 1:20 Retail packs. Exchange-result mail-in set is excluded.

productSets.name: Pro Bowl
productSets.notes: PB1-PB20 Holoview Pro Bowl insert set, inserted 1:20 packs. Pro Bowl Samples are excluded.
